name: Saddlery
_note: G4 (21 Nov 2026): the mount's building. Built on the Hearthtree's card once `needs_missions` missions are won and the Hearthtree is at `needs_home` (level 2, from 21 Nov 2026); levels 1-5, never above the Hearthtree's level; its level caps the level of every skill and attachment (mount_skills, mount_attachments). Its other rules are in the top-level `saddlery` block.
